messages:
carmen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we still have 4 action items without clear owners. Need to assign today so they get into the next sprint.

drew: I can take the alerting playbook update (INF-4321). Will create the Jira and estimate 3d.

alice: I'll own the KV cache eviction investigation notes + doc updates. Assign INF-4322 to me.

ben: I'll pair with Alice on eviction repro steps. Also can be backup owner for the monitoring alerts.

carmen: RACI proposal: R=drew, A=carmen, C=alice, I=ben for alerting. For KV eviction R=alice, A=carmen, C=ben, I=drew. ok?

alice: :thumbsup: agree

drew: Created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 — description + initial remedy hints. @carmen please add acceptance criteria.

carmen: Added acceptance criteria: 'Playbook includes runbook, contact list, post-deploy smoke test steps'

pm-bot: Reminder: due_date set for INF-4321 -> 2026-02-05 (auto-snooze if lacking owner)

ben: On recurring incidents: we saw similar eviction pattern in Nov/Dec. I want a small recurring-incidents label and a weekly triage until mitigated.

drew: Agree. I'll add label 'recurring-eviction' to INF-4322 and create a dashboard to show frequency.

alice: For handoffs: if owner is OOO, backup should be on the ticket. I'll add 'backup: ben' now.

carmen: Logistics: we'll sync in 30m in postmortem backlog channel to confirm timelines. @sre-oncall-bot please post a summary of owners to #postmortems-ops.

sre-oncall-bot: Summary posted: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/postmortems/p1758881234 — Owners: INF-4321 Drew, INF-4322 Alice; backups Ben. :white_check_mark:

drew: Closing note: who picks up 'quantization rollout checklist' (left unassigned)?

alice: I can do the checklist but need help with load test scripts. @ben can you help?

ben: Yep I can help. Let's set a 2-hour pairing session tomorrow.

carmen: Thanks all. I'll close this thread after the backlog-sync if nothing else.
